text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The day of the Sprinters Stakes has finally arrived. It's time to show off how hard I've been working.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we sure have been through a lot, haven't we? But you know, I really am glad you're my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to bloom into the most beautiful flower in the world, so please… Keep on watching over me.
